xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:BriefDetailsOfCyberSecurityInc: On 22-Oct-2025, IHCL received a notification from CERT-In (Ref: CERTIn-02110525) regarding an alleged data breach on “tajhotels.com” claimed by a threat actor who purportedly possessed approximately 810K member records containing PII such as name, email, phone number, gender and date/time. CERT-In shared screenshots and a reference link for verification. This incident was flagged by CERT-In based on there intelligence. A detailed internal investigation was immediately initiated which confirmed that the shared data samples were fake and no compromise of IHCL systems or customer data occurred. The incident was acknowledged to CERT-In within the stipulated timeline, findings were documented and security controls were revalidated. No regulatory breach or customer impact was noticed.

IHCL received complaints from some of our Customers under brand, Ama Stays and Trails, that they were receiving phishing emails & Whatsapp messages between 3rd and 5th November 2025 with details (First Name, Last name, Hotel Name, Arrival date, Departure date) of the reservation they have made via Online Travel Agents (MMT, Booking.com, Sabre etc) requesting payment for securing of their stay using a link provided in the spoof message. We use IDS Next as our software to capture reservations from various channels. We identified the issue on 12th of november with IDSnext and IDSnext confirmed such activities were noted in their environment for other customers as well. This incident was thereafter reported to CERT-In.

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: New Delhi Municipal Council (Taj Palace Delhi, Property Tax Case)
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: A Property Tax Bill of Rs 195.06 crs. was received, which comprised of Rs. 11.46 Cr. and rest towards past period. The Company has challenged the said demand by filing an IA in the pending Writ Petition. On the basis of earlier stay order the Court directed deposit of Rs. 5 crs within 4 weeks and stayed the entire impugned Demand. In compliance of the said Order, Rs. 5 crs was deposited. Further, property tax bill demanding Rs.11.45 Crs showing tax arrears of Rs.190 Crores was issued by NDMC to IHCL. IHCL has issued a reply to NDMC apprising that in view of stay granted by the Delhi High Court on earlier occasions in the pending writ petition, there is no basis to seek recovery of amount mentioned in the bill. Application seeking stay of such demand filed and pending for hearing.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Delhi High Court stayed the demand under Property Tax bill dated 28.05.2025 subject to deposit of Rs. 2 Crores by IHCL with NDMC within 4 weeks. In compliance of the same Rs. 2 Crores stands deposited with NDMC by IHCL.
